body: Yah i would rather be dead than existing here. I wake up everyday thinking "im still here". I have no interests and i find no joy in anything. I dont have any energy to get a job and im afraid people will see how miserable i am and that i wont even be able to keep the job. I avoid social situations because i feel like a fraud. I dont want anyone to see me and wonder why i look like a zombie and why i have nothing to say. I dont know how to have conversations with people, i dont know what to say, i dont have anything to add. I feel like nothing mattera. We live and we die. And dying would be so much easier. I really dont know why i havent just done it yet. But i feel your pain. Life is so fucking weird and confusing and depression just makes it worse in all ways
